subject: LedgerLink AP onboarding — vendor form, virtual IBAN & invoice template
messages:
From: Marion Kline <marion.kline@ledgerlink.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: AP Team <ap@ledgerlink.com>
Date: 2026-05-30 09:12 -0700
Subject: Redwood vendor registration & invoicing details

Hi Laura,

Quick intro — I’m Marion, the AP ops lead at LedgerLink. We’re ready to add Redwood as a vendor in our supplier registry so our payments team can start routing PO-backed payments. Before we create the profile we need a few things from you: 

- Completed vendor registration form (legal name, tax ids, bank remittance contact)
- Sample invoice that shows PO field placement, VAT breakdown, and a PDF + XML pair we can ingest
- Confirmation whether Redwood can accept payments to a virtual IBAN for EUR disbursements or if we should route to a multicurrency bank account
- Any requirements for PO validation (e.g., mandatory PO number format, allowed invoice line encoding)

Also heads-up: for European customers we commonly apply reverse-charge on some services; our tax team will need your VAT registration country and whether you remit VAT on B2B services.

Can you send the packet today? Our onboarding cutover for the 1st of the month is tight.

Thanks,
Marion Kline
AP Operations Lead
LedgerLink Inc

From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marion Kline <marion.kline@ledgerlink.com>
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.ai, ap@ledgerlink.com
Date: 2026-05-30 11:03 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood vendor registration & invoicing details

Hi Marion — thanks for the checklist and the heads-up. Attaching the completed vendor form and a sample invoice PDF. A few clarifications below to keep the cutover smooth:

- Legal / tax: Company name on legal docs is Redwood Inference, Inc.; VAT ID for EU billing is GB999999973 (we supply local VAT invoices when required).
- PO on invoices: we require the PO number in the invoice header and as an invoice line attribute called "PO_REF" for machine matching. Format is alphanumeric, usually starting with LL- or PO-; we can accept either.
- Invoice formats: we provide a human-readable PDF and an accompanying UBL-2.1 XML. The sample attached shows the XML element mapping we expect your ingestion to use.
- Virtual IBAN: Redwood can accept payments to a virtual IBAN for EUR settlements (we route into our EUR collection pool). If LedgerLink wants to use virtual IBANs, please share the remittance/beneficiary name to be associated in the portal; we'll provide the virtual account mapping for reconciliation.
- Payment terms / remittance: standard Net30 unless a PO has different terms. Early-pay discounts need to be encoded in the PO terms field so our billing team can assert.

Next steps I propose: 
1) I’m sending the vendor form + sample invoice now (see attachments).
2) If your payment team prefers virtual IBANs, mark that on the form and we’ll return the mapping within 24 hours.
3) Jordan from our finance team will confirm the VAT handling and share a one-page reconciliation guide for your AP system.

Can you confirm acceptance of the PDF+XML pair and whether your portal supports a PO_REF custom field?

Best,

Laura Bennett
Senior Partnerships Manager — Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0183

Attachments: LedgerLink_Vendor_Form.pdf, Redwood_Sample_Invoice.pdf

From: Tom Salazar <tom@salazar-corp.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: Marion Kline <marion.kline@ledgerlink.com>, aditya.rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-01 08:24 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood vendor registration & invoicing details

Laura / Marion — looping in Tom from LedgerLink payments (I handle the virtual account setup). A couple quick notes from our side: 

- We can register Redwood with a virtual IBAN. We need the beneficiary descriptor and the internal reference string (max 35 chars) you want tied to the virtual account.
- For automated reconciliation we prefer a single invoice-level XML element that contains the customer PO and the vendor reference (PO_REF). Can you confirm the XML path you use? (example: /Invoice/OrderReference/ID)
- VAT: League legal requires either your VAT country + number or a signed self-billing mandate for reverse-charge. 

If you can send the XML schema snippet and the preferred beneficiary descriptor, I’ll provision a test virtual IBAN this week.

Thanks,
Tom Salazar
Head of Payments — Salazar Corp (LedgerLink payments partner)

From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Salazar <tom@salazar-corp.com>, Marion Kline <marion.kline@ledgerlink.com>
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.ai, jordan.blake@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-02 15:04 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood vendor registration & invoicing details

Thanks Tom — details below so your team can provision the test account: 

- Beneficiary descriptor (for ledger): "REDWOOD INF - LL"
- Internal reference (max 35): "LL-RED-2026"
- XML path for PO: /Invoice/OrderReference/ID (we include PO_REF there and also in /Invoice/LegalMonetaryTotal/LineReference for line-level matching)
- VAT handling: Redwood Inference, Inc. will not charge VAT on B2B software services where reverse-charge applies; we can provide the VAT ID (GB999999973) and a signed self-billing agreement if LedgerLink requires it for their tax records. Jordan will attach the one-page reconciliation guide and the signed mandate in a follow-up.

Action items:
- Tom: provision a test virtual IBAN and share the account details and a test payment instruction (ideally via the secure drive link).
- Marion: confirm the portal can accept PO_REF at /Invoice/OrderReference/ID and that the vendor record will include the virtual IBAN mapping field.
- Jordan (cc'd): please add the reconciliation guide + signed self-billing mandate to the Drive folder and confirm when ready.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — happy to hop on a 20-minute call if that helps unblock the provisioning.

Laura

--
